summary: Inspected all 6 files in the hex-matrix unit. HexMatrix.lean is a pure import aggregator containing only public imports and a docstring — no declarations, proofs, or definitions of its own. The other five files (Basic.lean, Lists.lean, Notation.lean, Packed.lean, Scaled.lean) each contain substantial formal mathematical content: core matrix definitions and algebraic operations (Basic), structural integer list arithmetic and polynomial-style operations (Lists), matrix literal syntax and pretty-printing instances (Notation), Kronecker-packed dot product algorithms for certificate checking (Packed), and common-denominator rational encodings with arithmetic (Scaled). Per FILTER-007, pure import aggregators are navigation data and should not occupy primary mathematical result slots; all other files retain searchable formal mathematics.
